patch.value: Extract shared version-compat core (core/extensions/version-compat.ts); loader delegates, behavior-preserving

Move parseComparableVersion/compareComparableVersions out of loader.ts into a new pure core/extensions/version-compat.ts and add a pure synchronous bound evaluator (evaluatePmMinVersionBound/evaluatePmMaxVersionBound) returning structured {kind,status,allowed,required,current}. Loader keeps its async wrappers but delegates comparison+status to the shared evaluator and formats the SAME extension_pm_*_version_* warning strings verbatim. Single source of truth so author-time and runtime can never drift.
